purpose: Broaden fresh text-heavy validation and test coverage before selecting reranker scope or feature ablations.
legacy_policy: Retain the original 2000-image corpus and frozen train labels. Earlier validation/test families are diagnostic only and excluded from new model selection and new test aggregates.
new_sources: Legally reusable independently authored document scans and software screenshots with per-file source, attribution, license, content and pixel hashes. Include visible English, French and Arabic text. Group translations, pages of a work, screenshot software projects and near duplicates before splitting. No target selection from retrieval performance.
new_photo_controls: Seeded previously unjudged original-corpus photos from unused positive source components; review new families before retrieval. Retain their existing source split.
split_policy: Assign new document works and screenshot software project groups to train/validation/test before measuring rankings. Entire groups stay in one fold. Reject source/pixel and near-duplicate leakage with legacy images. Freeze image inventory, multilingual intents and reviewed labels before retrieval.
review: Visual agent review with observation and reason. Grade 2 direct, 1 partial, 0 explicitly irrelevant; ambiguous and missing labels remain unjudged. All translations of one intent share a family and labels. No independent human/native-speaker review claim.
training: Use only explicitly reviewed same-split training candidates. Fit normalization on train only, preserve existing family/translation and within-query class balancing. Keep candidate encoders and Tesseract unchanged.
selection: Evaluate the 40 predefined profile/scope/L2 combinations only on fresh validation families. Choose a guarded model by validation macro nDCG@10, then MRR@10, then stronger L2, then stable profile/scope name. If none passes, retain hybrid and report no guarded learned selection. Independently freeze the validation-best research champion for each scope before examining fresh test metrics.
test_policy: Freeze model checksums and selection records before scoring the new test. Evaluate hybrid, the two frozen scope champions and any distinct guarded selection; report legacy model as a fixed reference. No test-based feature, threshold or regularization changes. Report old families separately as diagnostic.
measurements: production request latency and sampled memory
deployment: Opt-in local JSON models only. Preserve v1 model compatibility, exact default hybrid ranking, and hybrid as default regardless of this experiment. No neural training in this study.
